title: No-Wire Lighting for Renters: Under-Cabinet and Wall Lights
description: Three renter-friendly lighting picks that need no wiring or drilling: motion under-cabinet lights, peel-and-stick sconces and magnetic puck lights.
dek: Rechargeable, stick-on and magnetic. Three ways to light a rental with no wiring.
hook: Rental lighting is stuck with the fixtures the landlord chose. These three picks add light with no wiring: they charge by USB, stick on, or attach with magnets.
I did not test these. I read each listing and use only what it says, so check the details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is or what size it is.
Anything that needs tools, wiring or a permanent change, for the renter and small-space guides.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and its size or capacity.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: Start with the under-cabinet lights if the counter is dark. Add the sconces for a bedside or reading corner.
hero_alt: A cozy kitchen counter at dusk with soft under-cabinet light, a mug, a plant and a linen-shaded wall sconce
